title: Shreya technical foundations curriculum crosswalk
authority: Curriculum review input. It does not approve learner-facing publication. Technical claims and named vendor examples require evidence review before release.

classification_legend.already-done-exactly: The concept is materially taught in the current source curriculum.
classification_legend.already-planned-exactly: The concept already exists as a named proposal but is not yet approved learner-facing content.
classification_legend.partial-expand: The curriculum covers the concept in context but needs an explicit foundation, distinction, or applied treatment.
classification_legend.new-addition: No material treatment was found. Add a governed proposal at the stated primary home.

items.title: Version control and GitHub
items.action: Retain the existing Git and GitHub proposal and record Shreya as an independent reinforcing contributor.

items.title: Environment variables and secrets
items.action: Retain the existing API key and .env proposal and attach Shreya's reinforcement.

items.title: APIs, endpoints, and API keys
items.action: Add an API literacy foundation before learners wire connectors, webhooks, or MCP tools.

items.title: Localhost, servers, and ports
items.action: Retain the existing web app and localhost proposal and attach Shreya's reinforcement.

items.title: Development, test, staging, and production environments
items.action: Keep the existing deployment subtopic and expand its exercise into promotion gates and no-testing-in-production behavior.

items.title: Cloud, hosting, SaaS, and on-premises
items.action: Add a plain-language deployment-location decision model covering ownership, residency, control, and operating responsibility.

items.title: JSON, YAML, CSV, and Markdown
items.action: Add a file-format field guide and a small identify, open, edit, and validate exercise.

items.title: Command line and terminal
items.action: Retain the existing terminal proposal and attach Shreya's reinforcement.

items.title: Database basics, SQL, and NoSQL
items.action: Add a relational and non-relational database primer before vector and graph databases.

items.title: Authentication and authorization
items.action: Add an identity foundation that distinguishes who you are from what you may do, then connect keys, OAuth, SSO, and roles.

items.title: HTTP, HTTPS, URLs, and encryption
items.action: Add basic web request and encryption-in-transit versus encryption-at-rest literacy.

items.title: Integrations, connectors, and webhooks
items.action: Make system-to-system events, payloads, credentials, and failure handling explicit before MCP practice.

items.title: Packages, dependencies, and versions
items.action: Retain the existing dependency-install proposal and attach Shreya's reinforcement.

items.title: Logs and audit trails
items.action: Distinguish operational logs, security logs, model traces, and governance audit records, including retention and access.

items.title: Rate limits, quotas, and token billing
items.action: Retain the existing cost and API proposals and attach Shreya's reinforcement.

items.title: Deploy, release, and rollback
items.action: Expand deployment into versioned release, health check, rollback trigger, rollback execution, and decision record.

items.title: Structured and unstructured data
items.action: Add an explicit classification exercise because data shape determines ingestion, retrieval, validation, and storage.

items.title: Hosted model API versus self-hosted model
items.action: Add a side-by-side architecture and governance decision table for API-hosted and self-hosted inference.

items.title: CPU versus GPU
items.action: Add a non-engineer compute primer tied to workload, latency, cost, energy, and hosting choices.

items.title: IP addresses, DNS, firewalls, and VPNs
items.action: Expand the domain lesson into a connectivity diagnostic for utility IT and OT boundaries.

items.title: Data pipelines and ETL
items.action: Already taught. Preserve Shreya's input as confirmation and link it to the existing data pipeline treatment.

items.title: Batch versus real-time and streaming processing
items.action: Add an architecture decision lesson using overnight reporting and live SCADA examples.

items.title: Latency and throughput
items.action: Add performance vocabulary and a simple workload sizing exercise.

items.title: Monitoring, metrics, and alerts
items.action: Extend evaluation into day-two operational monitoring, alert ownership, drift, and service health.

items.title: Timeouts, retries, and failure modes
items.action: Add resilient tool and agent behavior, including bounded retries, idempotency, graceful failure, and human escalation.

items.title: Testing basics and why AI testing differs
items.action: Already taught through evaluation sets, metrics, scoring, and continuous assurance. Use Shreya's framing as an entry bridge from software testing.

items.title: Backups, restore, and retention
items.action: Add restore testing, recovery objectives, retention windows, and ownership to the governed record treatment.

items.title: Data classification and PII
items.action: Already taught. Preserve Shreya's input as confirmation and emphasize hands-on classification practice.

items.title: Open source, proprietary software, and licensing
items.action: Add license obligations, model and data licenses, commercial-use limits, support, lock-in, and procurement checks.

items.title: Caching and stale data
items.action: Expand beyond prompt caching to browser, application, retrieval, and data caches, with freshness controls.

items.title: Containers and Docker
items.action: Already taught and practiced in the infrastructure and deployment module.

items.title: Frontend versus backend
items.action: Add a browser, server, API, database, and trust-boundary diagram before learners build a web application.

items.title: Sandboxing and least privilege
items.action: Already taught as a core AI security principle. Add Shreya as reinforcing contributor.

items.title: Data validation and schemas
items.action: Add required fields, types, formats, constraints, validation failures, and schema evolution before SHACL.

items.title: Entity resolution and deduplication
items.action: Already taught as identity resolution and reinforced in the spreadsheet cleanup proposal.

items.title: Time-series data
items.action: Add the foundational properties of timestamped operational data before lifecycle applications use it.

items.title: GIS and geospatial data
items.action: Add coordinate systems, layers, shapes, GeoJSON, spatial joins, and map-data governance for utility use cases.

items.title: Hashing and checksums
items.action: Add a tamper-evidence lab that hashes a file, changes it, and verifies the checksum no longer matches.

items.title: File and object storage versus databases
items.action: Add a storage-selection primer for documents, tabular records, vectors, and graph relationships.

items.title: Load, scaling, and uptime
items.action: Already taught in the infrastructure and deployment module. Link the production-readiness decision to explicit service objectives.

items.title: Cloud and GPU providers
items.action: Already taught through infrastructure, DigitalOcean, deployment, and model hosting. Treat named providers as dated examples, not endorsements.

items.title: Graph databases
items.action: Already taught in the knowledge graph machinery module, including Neo4j and GraphDB.

items.title: What a model is
items.action: Already taught across the foundational mental-model sequence.

items.title: Training versus inference
items.action: Already taught in how a model is made and how it produces an answer.

items.title: Hallucination and confident wrongness
items.action: Already taught throughout trust, retrieval, evaluation, and provenance.

items.title: Knowledge cutoff
items.action: Already taught explicitly as a reason retrieval and source grounding are needed.

items.title: Temperature and randomness
items.action: Already taught explicitly in the AI lexicon and inference explanation.

items.title: Prompting versus RAG versus fine-tuning
items.action: Already taught as a dedicated decision framework.

items.title: Bias in AI
items.action: Already taught in responsible AI, governance, privacy, and equity contexts.

items.title: Unreliable math and counting, and tool use
items.action: Add a calculator and database tool-use exercise that separates language generation from deterministic computation.

items.title: Structured model output
items.action: Add schema-constrained JSON output, validation, repair, and refusal handling as the bridge from chat to integration.

items.title: Vendor data use, retention, and prompt privacy
items.action: Already taught in data privacy and vendor evaluation. Preserve the exact executive question as a practical checklist prompt.

items.title: Model guardrails and application controls
items.action: Make the boundary explicit between provider refusals and application-owned input filters, output checks, permissions, and human gates.

items.title: Evals and evaluation metrics
items.action: Already taught in a dedicated module, including precision, recall, false positives, and false negatives.

items.title: Model families and sizes
items.action: Already covered in the current model landscape and exactly planned as a cost, latency, and capability selection exercise.

items.title: System prompt
items.action: Already taught as the standing role and rules behind user instructions and expanded in prompt engineering.
